quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer findings or actual quiz draws. Inspect direct symmetric/nontransitive pairs, actual complete titles, ordinary secondary senses and register. Exact titles deduplicate. Shared topics, homophony or an existing indirect exclusion do not establish a new pair. Assess excesses as well as omissions.

揃う assesses completeness, matching/equality and gathering; 揃える assesses collection, arrangement/preparation and uniformity. A full set is not every gathering, and preparation is not only purchasing missing items. The broad equality guards remain editorial judgments to review.

算盤's additional reckoning sense overlaps 計算/勘定 without equating an abacus and every calculation tool. 存じる/存ずる have identical titles and need no mutual exclusion; both assess actual knowing/thinking/feeling labels including unqualified ご存じ while teaching the honorific/humble distinction.
損得 assesses 長短's actual pros/cons sense. 田んぼ assesses actual 田/耕地 meanings, not dry-field 畑 merely by farming topic.

第一 assesses order, priority/best and additive discourse labels; important need not mean number-one priority. 大学院/学校 and 大工/職人 are broad-label safeguards, not identity equivalence with every school/craftsperson.

体系/体制 assess organized-system senses, not a rigid ideas/people partition. The broad 身体, 機関 and 交通機関 safeguards are reviewable hypotheses about actual labels and ordinary senses, not consequences copied through another exclusion.
対策 assesses actual plan/method/preparation labels; 大して assesses qualified negative-degree expressions. 対照 assesses comparison/checking against and contrast, not 対象/対称 by homophony.

大層 assesses degree, splendid evaluation, quantity and exaggeration separately. Inspect actual comparative ずっと and degree/quantity labels rather than assuming all are interchangeable. The broad quantity guards remain author hypotheses.
太鼓/体積 have no new declarations. 大小's baseline exclusions are unchanged; existing 寸法 already protects its direct pair. No claim of exhaustive semantic uniqueness is made.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty rows map nineteen new articles and narrow reuse of 大小. Its original body and metadata are preserved except newly sourced jlpt 2 and an appended dictionary citation. Specialized senses 3-6 remain outside the selected mapping.
Search-only source 田ぼ conflicts with pinned たんぼ restrictions. The normalized article reports that conflict explicitly rather than teaching an unrestricted pair. 存ずる's raw blank gloss remains blank.

算盤's abacus sense anchors its source mapping; figurative reckoning is additional. 存じる's thinking/feeling sense is also additional. Whole-word study classification does not settle historical origin; Kanjipedia groups 熟字訓 and 当て字 under one marker.

The inspected 246-family union includes twenty principals; it is not 246 additional families. Twenty-one supplemental families add twenty new identities. The original 377-family capture is not all asserted read. Nineteen supplemental old bodies add nineteen to 126 selected original bodies.
Four primary reciprocal pairs: 算/算盤, 損/損得, 照/対照, 層/大層. No old word has a link-only edit. Source-only 算 そろ and its caveat remain preserved.

Twenty-one positive Weblio endpoint captures are not twenty-one independent dictionaries. Kanjipedia's two pages are separate. Public captures are author retrievals, not fresh reviewer retrievals or frequency evidence.

File-only reviewers cannot independently execute Git/hash/equivalence checks. Structural validation, preservation checks and CLEAN judgments do not establish exhaustive correctness or runtime quiz uniqueness.

bodies.body:
ずっ‐と



［副］

１ ほかのものと比べてかけ離れているさま。段違いに。はるかに。「このほうが―大きい」「それより―以前の話だ」「駅は学校の―先にある」

２ 同じ状況が長く続いているさま。その間じゅう。「友だちのことで―悩んでいる」「夏休みは―家にいた」

３ ある範囲内に、残す所なく動作を及ぼすさま。くまなく。隅から隅まで。「広い校内を―探しまわる」「町じゅうを―見まわる」

４ ためらわずに、また、とどこおらずに動作をするさま。ずいと。「さあ、―お通りください」
